sources.title: ai-forever/rugpt3xl · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: rugpt3xl Model was trained with 512 sequence length using Deepspeed and Megatron code by SberDevices team, on 80B tokens dataset for 4 epochs. After that model was finetuned 1 epoch with sequence length 2048. Note! Model has sparse attention blocks. Total training time was around 10 days on 256 GPUs. Final perplexity on test set is 12.05. Model parameters: 1.3B.

sources.title: ruGPT3XL | ai-forever/ru-gpts | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview ruGPT3XL is an autoregressive transformer language model trained on a massive Russian language dataset. It features a unique implementation that combines DeepSpeed and Megatron frameworks with sparse attention patterns for memory efficiency. Unlike other models in the ru-gpts family that use standard HuggingFace implementation, ruGPT3XL uses a custom wrapper for simplified model usage ...

sources.snippet: This repository contains bunch of autoregressive transformer language models trained on a huge dataset of russian language. Russian GPT-3 models (ruGPT3XL, ruGPT3Large, ruGPT3Medium, ruGPT3Small) trained with 2048 sequence length with sparse and dense attention blocks.
